plan.summary: Faz 1 Paket 2: SuperAdmin API + Quota System. Plan CRUD (5 endpoints: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE plan_definitions), Tenant Plan Override (GET/PUT tenant plan_tier + features_json), Cache Invalidation (manual + auto after PUT/DELETE), Quota Foundations (tenant_usage table, TenantUsageService cache-based counter, Automation message quota check + max_flows guard). 5 new error codes (INV-BE-080..084).
plan.q_intent: SuperAdmin'in Dashboard uzerinden plan/feature/quota yonetimi yapabilmesi icin API altyapisi. Paket 1'de kurulan plan_definitions + TenantPlanCache uzerine CRUD + quota enforcement ekliyor.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/plans creates new tier, 409 on duplicate
DELETE /api/ops/plans/{tier} soft-deletes only if no active tenants (409 guard)
Automation message quota check blocks messages when exceeded (INV-AUTH-007)
Automation max_flows quota check blocks flow creation when exceeded
Full solution build PASS with 0 errors
